name: Serenolex

appearances.description: A small pale-blue oval tablet, scored down the middle on one side, imprinted "SNX 50".
A round, unscored white tablet, slightly smaller than the brand version, imprinted "54 292".

appearances.color: off-white with a faint yellow tint
appearances.description: A round tablet with a slightly warmer, off-white tone, imprinted "HV 50" in small type.

sideEffects: Mild nausea in the first 1-2 weeks
Headache when starting or adjusting dose

interactions.note: Can intensify drowsiness and dull emotional side effects tend to feel stronger — most people do best keeping intake light.
Combining with this sleep aid can compound sedation more than either alone. Space doses out and check with a prescriber.
No major concern, but taking together on an empty stomach can worsen nausea for some people.

name: Duskatrol

appearances.description: A two-tone navy-and-grey capsule, imprinted "DZ10" along the grey half.
A solid light-grey capsule imprinted simply with "10".

sideEffects: Occasional dizziness on standing up quickly

interactions.note: Significantly increases sedation and next-morning grogginess. Not recommended together.
Combining with this mood support medication can compound sedation more than either alone. Space doses out and check with a prescriber.

appearances.description: A small round, soft-pink tablet, scored on one side, imprinted "LV 10".
A round white tablet imprinted "L10" in a slightly larger typeface than the brand.

interactions.note: Can add to lightheadedness, especially when standing up. Stay hydrated and rise slowly.
Can raise potassium levels higher than expected together. Worth mentioning to a prescriber before combining.

name: Ferravix

appearances.description: A dark-green, glossy-coated oval tablet imprinted "FG65".
A plain, uncoated brownish-red round tablet with no imprint.

sideEffects: Stomach upset if taken without food

interactions.note: Can reduce how much iron your body absorbs. Best spaced an hour or two apart from either.
No major concern, but taking together on an empty stomach can worsen nausea for some people.

appearances.description: A small, pale-yellow, film-coated round tablet imprinted "AL 10".
A round white tablet, slightly chalkier in texture, imprinted "C10".

interactions.note: May increase drowsiness slightly more than either alone.
Both can cause drowsiness, so combining may leave you groggier than expected the next morning.

appearances.description: A large white oblong tablet, film-coated, imprinted "MF 500".
A slightly smaller off-white oblong tablet imprinted just "500".

interactions.note: Heavier drinking can affect blood sugar control and increase the chance of stomach upset.
Typically paused before and after imaging procedures that use contrast dye — flag this medication to any imaging staff.

name: Thyronorm
dosage: 75mcg, once daily on an empty stomach

appearances.description: A small, light-lilac round tablet imprinted "LT 75", noticeably thin.
A round, peach-colored tablet imprinted just "75" — a different color-coding convention than the brand.

sideEffects: Jitteriness if the dose runs slightly high

interactions.note: Can reduce absorption significantly if taken too close together. Best to wait at least 30-60 minutes.
Both can block absorption. Space doses at least four hours apart.
